The main takeaway from our work is that
social media use has become an important component of the campaign mix in Australia, but that it is not yet a game changer in the way that many have predicted and hoped.

social media use is still mostly promotional, and that social networks are still being used to push rather than pull content and information, and to build and manage relationships rather than to interact with them.
